test_title: SSC Selection Post Graduation Level Official Paper (Held on: 5 Aug 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Which of the following statements about Bharat Naujawan Sabha is INCORRECT?

options.text: It started political work among the youth, peasants, and workers.
Bhagat Singh became its founding secretary.

solution:
The correct answer is __**It was established in 1927.**____** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Bharat Naujawan Sabha** consists of members from the **Hindu, Muslim, and Sikh** groups and arranged **lectures, public meetings, and protests.** 
 
• It failed to gain widespread support due to its **radical ideas regarding religion and agrarian reform**.
 
• In **1925**, Bhagat Singh go back to Lahore and within the subsequent year, he and his colleagues started a militant youth organisation known as the **Naujawan Bharat Sabha.**
 
• We recall the founding of **Naujawan Bharat Sabha in 1926.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Naujawan Bharat Sabha was founded by** Bhagat Singh to foment revolution against the British Raj.** 
 
• Naujawan Bharat Sabha was **now one of the three notable left-wing groups in Punjab**, the others being the prohibited Communist Party of India and the **Kirti Kisan Party.​ **
 
• It was a more public face of the** Hindustan Republican Association**.
 
• Its popular leaders were:- **Bhagat Singh, Chandrasekhar Azad, Chabbil Das, Rajguru, Yashpal, Jaipal, etc.**
